boards.title: Your First Weekend at Transylvania University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A campus-centered, under-21-safe sequence for learning Transy’s main gathering, study, arts, recreation and dining spaces.

cards.entity_name: William T. Young Campus Center Information Desk
cards.title: Start with the Information Desk
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon • William T. Young Campus Center
cards.notes: Pick up a campus map, ask about current events, and note the lost-and-found location before setting out on your first campus loop.
cards.short_summary: A practical first stop for campus orientation and event assistance.
cards.evidence_claim: The Information Desk provides campus information, event assistance, campus maps, lost and found, and game-room assistance.
cards.access_notes: Academic-year Campus Center facility hours are daily, 8 a.m.–10:30 p.m.; the Information Desk is daily, 8 a.m.–10 p.m.

cards.title: Make a First Meet-Up at Back Circle
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon • campus courtyard
cards.notes: Use this residence-hall courtyard as a simple meet-up point, then walk together to the next stop rather than splitting up on day one.
cards.short_summary: A named campus green space surrounded by residence halls.
cards.evidence_claim: Back Circle is a student green space and courtyard surrounded by residence halls.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor-space access details are not stated on the source; follow campus guidance and any posted event restrictions.

cards.entity_name: J. Douglas Gay Jr./Frances Carrick Thomas Library
cards.title: Locate Your Library Help
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon • 300 N Broadway
cards.notes: Find the research desk and save the library contact details; return when you need a librarian, archives help, or a focused study setting.
cards.short_summary: A campus library with research support, special collections and archives.
cards.evidence_claim: The library offers reference-librarian research guidance, special collections, the Farris Rare Book Room, and Transylvania University archives.
cards.access_notes: The source lists the library address and contact information but does not state visitor or weekend hours; confirm before a dedicated visit.

cards.title: Pause Among the Alumni Bricks
cards.subtitle: Friday late afternoon • heart of campus
cards.notes: Sit at one of the tables, look closely at the engraved bricks, and use the plaza as a waypoint between Old Morrison and the arts buildings.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor campus plaza with tables, chairs and alumni-brick details.
cards.evidence_claim: Alumni Plaza is an outdoor campus space with tables and chairs where students study, eat and meet.
cards.access_notes: The source identifies it as an outdoor campus space; access specifics are not stated.

cards.title: See the Campus Landmark
cards.subtitle: Friday late afternoon • 251 W. Third St.
cards.notes: Walk to the lawn and exterior, then use the university’s self-guided-tour material to connect the building with Transy’s early history.
cards.short_summary: A National Historic Landmark and central Transy building.
cards.evidence_claim: Old Morrison was built in 1834, is a National Historic Landmark, and houses university administrative offices.
cards.access_notes: The source describes the building and its administrative offices; interior visitor access is not specified.

cards.title: Check What Is On at Mitchell
cards.subtitle: Friday evening • campus arts venue
cards.notes: Look for a scheduled performance or exhibition, and check the official event or ticket information before planning an indoor visit.
cards.short_summary: A Transy arts venue with theaters, a recital hall and Morlan Gallery.
cards.evidence_claim: Mitchell Fine Arts Center includes Carrick Theater, Haggin Auditorium, Coleman Recital Hall and Morlan Gallery; it hosts performance, school, community and academic events.
cards.access_notes: Events and ticketing vary; consult the venue’s current listing before attending.

cards.title: Walk Past the Athletics Complex
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning • Fourth Street
cards.notes: Use the marked campus-map destination for a daylight walk-by and learn which Pioneer teams use the track-and-field complex.
cards.short_summary: A Transy athletics complex for field hockey, lacrosse, soccer and track and field.
cards.evidence_claim: The Transylvania Athletic Complex has an 860-seat grandstand, eight-lane track and artificial-turf field for field hockey, lacrosse, soccer and track and field.
cards.access_notes: The complex is listed as a campus facility; event attendance and building access depend on the schedule.

cards.title: Plan Dinner at the Raf
cards.subtitle: Saturday evening • Young Campus Center
cards.notes: Check the current dinner window, then meet your group at the Raf rather than relying on a meal schedule from an older orientation handout.
cards.short_summary: A named Transy dining location with breakfast service listed on the Campus Center page.
cards.evidence_claim: The Campus Center’s information page lists breakfast service in the Raf on weekdays from 7–9 a.m.
cards.access_notes: The cited page identifies breakfast hours for the Raf but does not list Saturday dinner hours; confirm current dining service before going.

cards.entity_name: William T. Young Campus Center Game Room
cards.title: Try the Game Room
cards.subtitle: Saturday evening • Young Campus Center
cards.notes: Bring a valid photo ID if you want to rent a game, and use the listed academic-year hours to keep this stop inside the building schedule.
cards.short_summary: An indoor Campus Center activity space with stated academic-year hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The Game Room is in the William T. Young Campus Center and requires a valid photo ID to rent any game.
cards.access_notes: Academic-year Game Room hours are daily, 12 p.m.–10 p.m.; a valid photo ID is required to rent a game.

cards.title: Finish with Late-Night Dining
cards.subtitle: Saturday night • Young Campus Center
cards.notes: If you need an evening food stop, verify the posted menu and use the university’s listed late-night window before the Campus Center closes.
cards.short_summary: A Campus Center dining room with a published late-night dining period.
cards.evidence_claim: The Campus Center information page lists late-night dining from 7–9 p.m. and identifies the Great Hall Dining Room at the North Broadway entrance.
cards.access_notes: Late Night Dining is listed daily, 7–9 p.m.; academic-year Campus Center facility hours are daily, 8 a.m.–10:30 p.m.
